The name "Baal'Thamut" appears to be a portmanteau of "Baal" and "Bahamut".

"Baal"-word alone in this context could tell a progression story of Baal'Thasar rising from a humble (Hebrew / Phoenician) "lord / master" into an omnipotent (Baalim) "great god" alongside being a (Christian) fallen angel / demon / saint.[1]
While generally the mythological "
" is depicted as a gargantuan fish (or a whale), in some depictions the roles of Bahamut and
have been switched around (and vice versa), making Bahamut having more of a serpentine appearance.[2]

The spell "eatingtheground" is likely a reference to the song "Serpent Eating The Ground" (technically a mistranslation of "Serpent Eating the Horizon"), the final boss theme of the 2012 role-playing game
. The character's description in the menu references both variations on the song name.
